fire-door-compliance.name: Fire Door Compliance
fire-door-compliance.seo_title: Fire Door Compliance | Inspection & Remedials North West
fire-door-compliance.intro: Fire door compliance means doors that are supposed to hold back smoke and fire still do that job — gaps, seals, closers and unauthorised ironmongery included. iComply inspects and reports fire door compliance for blocks and workplaces across the North West, then quotes remedials as POA.
fire-door-compliance.body: We walk the escape routes and high-risk rooms, measure gaps, check intumescent strips, smoke seals, hinges, glazing and self-closing devices, and note doors that have been planed, wedged or fitted with the wrong lock. The report feeds your FRA actions. Some doors can be repaired with certified methods; others need a new certificated leaf. We do not invent a per-door pound price on the website — layouts and door counts decide the quote.
fire-door-compliance.meta_desc: Fire door compliance inspections and remedials for blocks and commercial sites. Defect reports, FRA support, POA quotes from Stockport.
fire-door-compliance.seo_keywords: fire door compliance, fire door inspection, fire door survey North West, FD30 inspection Stockport, compartmentation doors
focus_points: Inspection of leaves, frames, seals, closers and ironmongery
FRA action support for responsible persons
Remedial quotes after the survey — POA, not a web price list
faq: It is evidence that fire doors still perform — not just that they were once labelled FD30 or FD60. Inspection looks at the whole doorset and how it is used.
How often should fire doors be checked?
Formal inspections follow the building risk and your FRA. Many blocks add routine caretaker checks between formal visits.
Do you publish a price per door?
No. Door count, access and whether leaves can be repaired versus replaced are scoped first. Ask for a written POA quote.

epc.name: EPC
epc.seo_title: EPC | Energy Performance Certificate North West
epc.intro: An EPC (energy performance certificate) is the document buyers, tenants and listing portals expect when a home is marketed. iComply arranges domestic EPCs for landlords and sellers across Greater Manchester and the North West from our Stockport base. Fees are POA after we know the property type — we do not invent a website pound price.
epc.body: The assessor walks the property, records construction, heating, insulation and lighting, and lodges the certificate on the national register. We are honest when a full commercial EPC or a retrofit design is a different job. Combine an EPC with an EICR or gas safety visit on a void when dates line up. Recommendations on the EPC are not a quote for works; ask if you want those items priced separately.
epc.meta_desc: EPC (energy performance certificate) for lets and sales in Greater Manchester and the North West. Stockport assessors, POA after property type.

faq: How long does an EPC last?
A domestic EPC is typically valid for ten years unless you replace it earlier for a new listing or after major works.
